messages.content: Tell me some of the major airports in the United States.

message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, sorted roughly by passenger traffic (largest to smaller but still significant):

| Airport | City | State | IATA Code | Notable Features |
|---------|------|-------|-----------|------------------|
| Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport | Atlanta | GA | ATL | Largest airport in the world by passenger traffic; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| Los Angeles International Airport | Los Angeles | CA | LAX | Major gateway to Asia and the Pacific; one of the busiest airports on the West Coast. |
| Chicago O’Hare International Airport | Chicago | IL | ORD | One of the busiest airports in the world; major hub for United Airlines and American Airlines. |
| Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport | Dallas/Fort Worth | TX | DFW | Largest airport in the United States by land area; major hub for American Airlines. |
| Denver International Airport | Denver | CO | DEN | Largest airport in the United States by land area; major hub for United Airlines and Southwest Airlines. |
| John F. Kennedy International Airport | New York City | NY | JFK | Major international gateway; hub for many airlines including Delta and American. |
| San Francisco International Airport | San Francisco | CA | SFO | Major hub for United Airlines; key gateway to Asia and the Pacific. |
| Seattle–Tacoma International Airport | Seattle | WA | SEA | Major hub for Alaska Airlines and a growing hub for Delta. |
| Miami International Airport | Miami | FL | MIA | Major hub for American Airlines; key gateway to Latin America and the Caribbean. |
| Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport | Phoenix | AZ | PHX | Major hub for American Airlines; one of the busiest airports in the Southwest. |
| Charlotte Douglas International Airport | Charlotte | NC | CLT | Major hub for United Airlines; one of the busiest airports in the Southeast. |
| Orlando International Airport | Orlando | FL | MCO | Major hub for Southwest Airlines; key gateway to tourism destinations in Florida. |
| Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport | Detroit | MI | DTW | Major hub for Delta Air Lines; one of the busiest airports in the Midwest. |
| Newark Liberty International Airport | Newark | NJ | EWR | Major hub for United Airlines; key gateway to the Northeast. |
| Washington Dulles International Airport | Washington, D.C. | VA | IAD | Major hub for United Airlines; key gateway to the nation's capital. |
| Minneapolis–Saint Paul International Airport | Minneapolis | MN | MSP | Major hub for Delta Air Lines; key gateway to the Upper Midwest. |
| Boston Logan International Airport | Boston | MA | BOS | Major hub for JetBlue Airways; key gateway to New England. |
| San Diego International Airport | San Diego | CA | SAN | Major hub for Southwest Airlines; key gateway to Southern California. |
| Baltimore/Washington International Thurgood Marshall Airport | Baltimore | MD | BWI | Major hub for Southwest Airlines; key gateway to the Mid-Atlantic. |
| Salt Lake City International Airport | Salt Lake City | UT | SLC | Major hub for Delta Air Lines; key gateway to the Rocky Mountains. |

These airports are among the busiest in the United States and serve as major hubs for both domestic and international travel.
